name: Crispy Prosciutto, Peach & Mozzarella Sandwich with Italian Salad
instructions: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Divide prosciutto between two baking sheet pans and arrange in an single layer. Working in batches, place in the oven and broil until crispy, 2-3 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, quarter peaches lengthwise (around the pit); twist quarters to separate, then remove and discard pit. Cut each quarter into thin wedges and place on a plate.
Thinly slice tomatoes, then season with salt and pepper; add to the plate with the peach.
Thinly slice mozzarella into rounds; add to the plate.
Add one lettuce leaf per sandwich to the plate and set aside. Chop or tear remaining lettuce into bite-sized pieces and place in a medium bowl.
Drain and thinly slice artichokes; add to the bowl with the lettuce and set aside.
Spread mayo over each bread slice. Layer half of the slices with lettuce, tomato, mozzarella, peach, and crispy prosciutto. Close with remaining bread slices.
Add dressing to the bowl with the lettuce and artichokes; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad and sandwiches between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
